title: Senior Capability Analyst
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the Product Owner for one or more formulary management applications, providing strategic direction and day-to-day oversight of product capabilities
* Act as the primary voice of the business and end users, ensuring product priorities align with organizational goals and customer needs
* Define and communicate product vision, strategy, and roadmap to Agile delivery teams and stakeholders
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to support successful solution delivery
* Evaluate business value, develop use cases, and prioritize the product backlog to maximize value delivery and achieve targeted outcomes
* Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization activities to ensure development efforts align with business objectives
* Partner closely with Scrum Masters, business stakeholders, and technology teams to identify and resolve impediments impacting delivery.
* Foster collaboration across Product Owners, Scrum teams, and cross-functional partners to support enterprise-scale Agile initiatives
* Facilitate and actively participate in Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and demonstrations
* Ensure compliance with governance and audit requirements by supporting the creation and maintenance of required documentation and deliverables
* Monitor industry trends, emerging technologies, and Agile best practices to continuously improve product management and delivery processes
* Collaborate with business and technology partners to assess incoming enhancement requests, estimate effort, and determine implementation priorities
* Work directly with stakeholders to understand business challenges, identify opportunities for improvement, and define solution requirements
* Analyze operational processes, user feedback, and performance metrics to identify enhancements that improve efficiency, user experience, and business outcomes
* Support release planning, user acceptance testing, and production readiness activities to ensure successful product deployments
* Build and maintain strong relationships with business, operational, and technology partners to drive alignment and product success
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* 3+ years PBM or pharmacy experience
* 3+ years of experience working as a Business Analyst or Product Owner
* Experience with project methodology (requirements, design, development, test and implementation)
* Experience presenting to stakeholders, written release notes, documentations of requirements, etc.
* Experience leading project workstream, deliverables, timelines

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working with Agile process and principles
* Client facing experience
* Experience with formulary management and drug data
* Experience with RxClaim or RxBuilder

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Technical Team Lead – Microsoft Biz Apps & AI Transformation
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

We are seeking an experienced **Technical Team Lead – Microsoft Business Applications & AI Transformation** to lead the design, development, and delivery of enterprise solutions built on the Microsoft Business Applications platform. In this role, you will provide technical leadership for Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O), Power Platform, Dataverse, Azure, and emerging AI capabilities, helping clients accelerate their digital transformation initiatives.

You will work closely with clients, solution architects, functional consultants, and development teams to design scalable, high-quality solutions that solve complex business challenges. As a technical leader, you will mentor engineers, drive technical excellence, and ensure successful project delivery from architecture through implementation.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the technical design, development, and implementation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations solutions.
* Design scalable solution architectures leveraging Microsoft Business Applications, Azure, Power Platform, Dataverse, and AI capabilities where appropriate.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, and project teams to gather, analyze, and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients, providing guidance throughout project delivery.
* Lead technical workstreams including custom development, integrations, data migration, and systems engineering.
* Drive solution quality through architecture reviews, code reviews, technical documentation, testing, and governance processes.
* Identify technical risks, recommend mitigation strategies, and proactively resolve complex implementation challenges.
* Collaborate with project managers to support project planning, prioritization, and successful delivery across multiple engagements.
* Mentor and develop technical consultants through coaching, code reviews, and technical leadership.
* Stay current with Microsoft technologies and drive the adoption of best practices across Dynamics 365, Azure, Power Platform, and AI-enabled solutions.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience developing and implementing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (or Dynamics AX) solutions.
* 5+ years of consulting or professional services experience working with enterprise clients.
* Strong expertise in X++ development and customization within Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.
* Experience designing and implementing enterprise solution architectures for Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.
* Working knowledge of Azure services, Power Platform, and Dataverse for end-to-end Microsoft Business Applications solutions.
* Experience leading technical teams or technical workstreams on enterprise implementation projects.
* Strong understanding of integrations, data migration, and systems engineering concepts.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage technical and business audiences, including senior client leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, solve complex technical problems, and deliver high-quality solutions in a collaborative environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Microsoft certifications related to Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, Power Platform, Azure, or Microsoft Business Applications.
* Experience incorporating Microsoft AI technologies, including Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, or AI-powered automation, into enterprise solutions.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM) certification.
* Experience mentoring and developing technical teams in a consulting environment.
* Knowledge of C#/.NET and modern integration patterns is a plus.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  
  
**How You Can Grow:**  
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  
  
**More about Crowe:**

Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.

Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: Senior IT Program & Project Management Analyst
description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission\-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments \- creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.

  

  

**Job Track Description:**


The Senior IT Program \& Project Management Analyst is responsible for supporting the planning, execution, governance, reporting, and delivery of IT projects. This role partners with delivery teams, business stakeholders, product owners, and technology leaders to ensure successful delivery of IT initiatives.


The position provides PMO leadership, project controls, portfolio reporting, risk and issue management, schedule governance, resource planning support, and executive\-level communications while driving consistency with organizational project management standards and best practices.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Project Governance**


* Support execution of multiple IT projects across the organization.
* Establish and maintain project governance processes, standards, and controls.
* Facilitate project reviews and status reporting.
* Ensure compliance with project management methodologies and organizational standards.
* Track project performance against scope, schedule, budget, and quality objectives.

**Planning and Delivery Management**


* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, roadmaps, milestones, and dependencies.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams to ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.
* Monitor project progress and proactively identify schedule variances.
* Support release planning, implementation planning, and delivery readiness activities.

**Risk, Issue, and Dependency Management**


* Maintain project risk, issue, action item, and decision logs.
* Facilitate identification, assessment, and mitigation of delivery risks.
* Escalate critical issues and dependencies to leadership with recommended corrective actions.
* Monitor mitigation plans through resolution.

**Reporting and Executive Communication**


* Prepare executive\-level project status reports.
* Develop dashboards, KPIs, and portfolio metrics.
* Present project health, risks, achievements, and delivery forecasts to leadership.
* Generate management reports using project management and reporting tools.

**Financial Management**


* Assist with project budget monitoring and financial reporting.
* Track project expenditures and identify budget variances.

**Stakeholder Management**


* Collaborate with business leaders, technology teams, vendors, and customers.
* Facilitate meetings, workshops, planning sessions, and governance reviews.
* Drive stakeholder alignment on priorities, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
* Ensure effective communication across all levels of the organization.

**PMO Process Improvement**


* Identify opportunities for improving project delivery processes.
* Drive adoption of Agile, Scrum, SAFe, and project management best practices.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives across the PMO.

**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in IT project management, PMO, or project governance roles.
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise technology initiatives.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies including Waterfall, Agile, Scrum, and SAFe.
* Experience managing cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams.

**Required Skills**


* Project management
* Project planning and scheduling
* Risk and issue management
* Stakeholder management
* Financial and resource management
* Executive reporting and presentations
* Requirements tracking and traceability
* Change management
* Vendor management
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

**Preferred Tools Experience**


* Microsoft Project
* Azure DevOps (ADO)
* Microsoft Office
* Microsoft Power BI

**Preferred Certifications**


* PMP (Project Management Professional)
* SAFe Agilist (SA)
* PRINCE2 Practitioner
* Scrum Master Certification
